parameters.name: FunctionBlockId
parameters.description:
The identifier of the custom module in the Thing Specification Language model. The identifier must be unique within the product. It can contain uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_), and cannot exceed 30 characters in length.

This parameter must be used together with **FunctionBlockName**. If you do not specify this parameter, the features are added to the default module.

parameters.name: FunctionBlockName
parameters.description:
The name of the custom module in the Thing Specification Language model. The name can contain Chinese characters, letters, Japanese characters, digits, and underscores (_). The name must be 4 to 30 characters in length. A Chinese character or a Japanese character counts as one character.

This parameter must be used together with **FunctionBlockId**. If you do not specify this parameter, the features are added to the default module.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If this **ID** value exists, you must specify it. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the **Overview** page or **ID** value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description:
The **ProductKey** of the product. This is the globally unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for the product.

You can view the information of all products under the current account in the IoT Platform console or by calling the [QueryProductList](~~69271~~) operation.

parameters.name: ThingModelJson
parameters.description:
The details of the features to add. You can include the definitions of up to 10 features.

In each property structure of **ThingModelJson**, you can use **extendConfig** to describe the extended TSL model data. For more information, see [ThingModelJson data description](~~150457~~).

><notice>The **ThingModelJson** parameter does not accept complete TSL data. Specify only the **properties**, **services**, and **events** fields in JSON format.
></notice>

The following example shows property data that contains multiple data types, such as **STRUCT** and **ARRAY**.
```
{
  "properties": [
    {
      "custom": true,
      "dataSpecsList": [
        {
          "childDataType": "TEXT",
          "childName": "Device SIM card CCID",
          "dataSpecs": {
            "custom": true,
            "dataType": "TEXT",
            "length": 20
          },
          "dataType": "STRUCT",
          "identifier": "CCID",
          "name": "Device SIM card CCID"
        },
        {
          "childDataType": "INT",
          "childName": "Battery level",
          "dataSpecs": {
            "custom": true,
            "dataType": "INT",
            "max": "60000",
            "min": "0",
            "step": "1"
          },
          "dataType": "STRUCT",
          "identifier": "battery",
          "name": "Battery level"
        },
        {
          "childDataType": "TEXT",
          "childName": "Other information",
          "dataSpecs": {
            "custom": true,
            "dataType": "TEXT",
            "length": 1024
          },
          "dataType": "STRUCT",
          "identifier": "other_info",
          "name": "Other information"
        }
      ],
      "dataType": "STRUCT",
      "identifier": "DEV_INFO",
      "name": "Device information",
      "productKey": "a1T***",
      "propertyId": 18786548,
      "required": false,
      "rwFlag": "READ_ONLY"
    },
    {
      "custom": true,
      "dataSpecs": {
        "childDataType": "INT",
        "custom": true,
        "dataType": "ARRAY",
        "size": 1,
        "dataSpecs": {
          "custom": true,
          "dataType": "INT",
          "max": "65535",
          "min": "0",
          "step": "1",
          "unit": "ppm",
          "unitName": "parts per million"
        }
      },
      "dataType": "ARRAY",
      "identifier": "airRH_SR",
      "name": "Dehumidifier humidity",
      "productKey": "a1T***",
      "propertyId": 18786551,
      "required": false,
      "rwFlag": "READ_ONLY"
    }
  ],
  "services": [...],
  "events": [...]
}
```
